question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I find that students nowadays are not interested in _________ letters by hand.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"writing"** refers to the activity or skill of composing text. (लेखन)

 
 
• **Example: **She spent the afternoon** writing** a letter to her friend.
 
 
 
• **"Righting" **refers to making a situation or a mistake correct. (सही करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company is** righting** its wrongs by offering refunds to unsatisfied customers.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the given sentence, the correct word is **'writing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Righting **(सही करना): Making something correct.

 
 
• **Example:** She focused on righting her past mistakes.
 
 
 
• **Rating **(मूल्यांकन): Assessing or evaluating something.
 
 
• **Example: **The movie received a high rating from the critics.
 
 
 
• **Rioting **(दंगा): Taking part in a violent disturbance.
 
 
• **Example:** The people were rioting in the streets due to the political unrest.
